events.title: Energy Shortage
events.text: Energy supply falls 20%, energy prices rise and factory input costs increase.

events.title: Resource Discovery
events.text: New deposits increase timber and iron availability and lower their prices.

events.title: Supply Disruption
events.text: Material supply falls and procurement prices rise.

events.title: Demand Boom
events.text: Strong spending lifts customer demand by 35%.

events.title: Recession
events.text: Economic activity slows and customer demand falls by 30%.

events.title: Natural Disaster
events.text: Severe weather damages resource output and raises affected material prices.

events.title: Technology Breakthrough
events.text: A manufacturing breakthrough lowers input prices and lifts market demand.
